title: Search across consolidated facts (not just raw working-memory turns) and re-score the full suite
summary: Change run_retrieval_quality() to query store.facts (or a combined working+facts search) now that BENCH-3a/3b produce consolidated records; re-run Run B's exact config and publish the before/after category deltas in BENCHMARKS.md.
description:
Third sub-story closing out the Consolidator/Reconciler fix. Today `run_retrieval_quality()` only ever calls `store.working.search()` — raw turns, never `store.facts`. With BENCH-3a's Consolidator promoting multi-session facts into single `SemanticFact` records and BENCH-3b's Reconciler superseding stale ones, the search step needs to actually use them: either search `store.facts` in addition to (or instead of) `store.working`, merging/deduping results, or make the search target configurable so both modes stay comparable.

Re-run the exact Run B configuration (`--suite retrieval --baseline --embedding-provider ollama --judge ollama:llama3.1:8b --dataset-size 10 --seed 42`) with consolidation+reconciliation now wired in, and record the new category-by-category deltas as a new dated run in BENCHMARKS.md, directly comparable to Run B — this is the number that proves (or disproves) whether ENH-3/ENH-4 wiring actually closes the multi_session/temporal_reasoning/knowledge_update gap the epic set out to fix. If the gap doesn't close as expected, say so plainly rather than declaring victory.

Before starting: read DECISIONS.md in full, including BENCH-3a/3b's entries. Before finishing: append a dated DECISIONS.md entry with the full before/after comparison and an honest assessment of whether this closed the gap. Set BENCH-3c's status to "Done" in BOARD.html with a comment summarizing the before/after deltas, then `git add -A && git commit -m "bench-3c: search consolidated facts in retrieval-quality suite, re-score"`.

comments.text: Done. Run D: 98.0% (49/50) with-SDK vs. 98.0% (49/50) baseline — delta +0.0%. Run B→D: extraction +10%, multi_session +30%, temporal_reasoning +30%, knowledge_update +10%, abstention -10% (judge noise), Overall +14.0%. Three contributing changes: (1) BaseRepository.create()/update() embedding fix — when enable_chunking=False and _embedding_provider is set, compute real embeddings for short content instead of zero-vector sentinel (primary driver; without this, VECTOR_DISTANCE raised SQL0801N on Db2); (2) BenchmarkConsolidator + search_facts=True combined working+facts merged search (BENCH-3a/3c); (3) BenchmarkReconciler supersession excludes stale knowledge_update facts at DB layer before search() is called (BENCH-3b). run_retrieval_quality() gains search_facts: bool = False kwarg. run_benchmarks.py gains --consolidator benchmark / --reconcile / --search-facts flags. 542 unit tests pass; ruff clean; mypy strict clean. BENCHMARKS.md Run D + summary table updated. DECISIONS.md entry appended.
